description: Search the World Bank indicator catalog by keyword, topic, or source for indicator IDs to pass to worldbank_get_data. Provide at least one of query, topic_id, or source_id; together they combine by AND. Exact ID or name matches rank first, then names starting with the phrase as whole words, whole-phrase matches, matches where every term is a whole word of the ID or name, other ID or name matches, and description-only matches; within each, World Development Indicators come first, then other live sources, then archives; among names starting with the phrase, one continuing it with ", total" leads its source (Population, total for population); and a series precedes its breakdowns by sex, area, or age. Each indicator ID appears once, even when two sources publish it.

per_page.description: Results per page (default: server default); sizes above 3000 are served at that maximum, with a notice.

query.description: Keywords, an indicator name, or an ID (e.g. "GDP per capita", "NY.GDP.MKTP.CD"); every term must match the ID, name, or full description, in any order. Punctuation is ignored, so it needs a letter or digit.

source_id.description: Source ID from worldbank_list_sources (e.g. "2" for World Development Indicators).

topic_id.description: Topic ID from worldbank_list_topics (e.g. "3" for Economy & Growth).

name: worldbank_search_indicators

appliedFilters.description: Parameters in force for these results; a filter not applied is omitted.

perPage.description: Page size served, after any reduction to the page maximum.

requestedPerPage.description: Page size asked for, or the server default; present only when perPage was reduced.

currentPage.description: Page number; past totalPages when the request ran off the end.

effectiveQuery.description: The applied filters as one string.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_filter`: No query, topic_id, or source_id. `invalid_filter`: Unknown topic_id or source_id. `empty_query`: query has no letter or digit. `upstream_timeout`: The World Bank Indicators API did not answer within the call's 50-second budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

sourceNote.description: Indicator description, cut to its first 150 characters and marked with … when longer; worldbank_get_indicator returns it whole.

notice.description: Explains an empty result (how to broaden it), a page past the end, or a reduced page size.

title: Search World Bank Indicators
